summary: Live lane of a busy arterial, clearway with tow away.

drivers.seclusion: Fully exposed on a wide arterial; no dwellings within 15 m but buildings and a kindergarten nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: The line sits in the traffic lane; no verge or pull-off to stop clear of it.
drivers.convention: Cars drive through, none parked on this kerb; clearway signed.

flags: Low-lying: Witton Creek about 255 m away, elevation about 45 m so not a flood concern
sun_shade: Open; trees shade the north side.
cannot_judge: Kerbside restrictions outside the clearway hours
